# Slate & Cove

> Full-service short-let and Airbnb management for landlords in London and the
> Home Counties. We create and optimise the listing, price it daily against
> local demand, host and vet guests around the clock, clean between every stay,
> coordinate maintenance, and report once a month.

Slate & Cove manages short lets end to end so the owner has no day-to-day
involvement. Landlords typically earn 30–40% more than a standard long-term
tenancy.

## Pricing

- Full-time plan: 15% of net revenue. Property available all year round,
  minimum six-month commitment.
- Flexible plan: 18% of net revenue. 30-day rolling contract, block out any
  dates you need, no minimum availability.
- Commission is calculated on net revenue after platform fees. VAT may apply.
- No setup fees. Cleaning, maintenance and consumables are passed through at
  cost, not covered by the management fee.

## What is included

Listing optimisation, professional photography, dynamic pricing, guest
communication and screening 24/7, cleaning and linen, maintenance
coordination, review management, and a monthly report covering occupancy,
revenue, expenses and net payout. Listings run on Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo,
Expedia and Blueground. Short-let compliance including the 90-night rule is
tracked.

## Areas covered

Central London: Kensington, Notting Hill, Paddington, Little Venice & Maida
Vale, Earls Court, Chelsea, Southbank, Farringdon, Elephant & Castle.
London zones 2–4: Hammersmith, Barons Court, Fulham, Shepherd's Bush,
Chiswick, Brentford, Kew, Acton, Ealing, Wembley, Hounslow, Canary Wharf,
Whitechapel, Battersea, Wandsworth.
Greater London: Harrow, Hayes, Yeading, Uxbridge.
Berkshire: Slough, Windsor, Maidenhead, Reading, Bracknell, Ascot.
Hertfordshire, Surrey & Buckinghamshire: Watford, Staines, Beaconsfield.

## Onboarding

Consultation, onboarding (photography, listing creation, pricing setup), go
live, ongoing management, monthly payout. Most properties are live within one
to two weeks of signing; as little as 7 days when already guest-ready.
